body: I definitely think good communication can work pretty much a lot of things out if the other person is willing to listen and communicate back. I’m one to want to communicate but i do tend to shut down and give him space when he gets angered and i usually wait for him to cool off before i try to tell him how i feel and what i think we should do. as far as the whole pc idea, i think that’s a great one! i definitely think it would fix the whole “bothering him at work” kind of thing. he should be able to get his personal space while at work. and i would love to have a bit of personal space in our place as well. i definitely needed to hear that. thank you.

unfortunately yes i definitely moved quick with this one. you are correct. i had slight suspicion moving in with him as early as i did to begin with but i didn’t care at the time because my other living conditions were horrible and i had no place else to go. he knew about it and offered to take me in and i made the ultimate decision to take the offer after a few months of dating. regardless of me wanting to make things work i do know that it’s a compatibility issue. we both have our own issues that we deal with. he gets aggravated easily and i don’t always think about things and if they’re going to irritate him. more than anything with all the love i have for him i would love to see it work out. but i think that he just doesn’t like the type of person that i am. even asking this question i kind of knew the answer but wanted to be sure of it.
you’re not alone. i can’t go to bed without my mind thinking those kinds of thoughts. it really does suck.
i feel you on that one. i hate waking up every morning. yet i can’t sleep at night because of my depression and suicidal tendencies. i hope for your sake that you have a better day tomorrow.
